description.text:
The eighth enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 17 June 2022, built on the world of the smartphone game Pokémon GO, and many of its cards bear the Pokémon GO logo. Mewtwo VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power attack does 120 damage to each of the opponent's Pokémon V, leads it, with Melmetal VMAX and Meltan, the mythical Pokémon first found in Pokémon GO, Dragonite VSTAR, Alolan Exeggutor V, Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres, whose Abilities power up the Basic Pokémon of their type, and Radiant Venusaur, Radiant Charizard, Radiant Blastoise and Radiant Eevee. Its Trainer cards bring in the game's PokéStop and Lure Module and its three team leaders, Candela, Spark and Blanche. Each pack held six cards and a code for Pokémon GO. The cards are numbered to 71, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, with Mewtwo V and Conkeldurr V also drawn as special art and Professor Willow on Professor's Research, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR and VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Mewtwo VSTAR, Egg Incubator and Lure Module. In English many of its cards came out in the Pokémon GO set in July 2022.

Some cards show Pokémon in photographic settings, as if they had stepped into the real world, such as Pikachu walking beside its Trainer and Gyarados rising in a city street, and the eight basic Energy, all holo with the Pokémon GO logo, first appeared here. A few cards look like ordinary Pokémon such as Bidoof but carry a Ditto mark in place of the regulation mark: their face is a sticker that peels off to show Ditto, and they can't be used in official tournaments until it is peeled.
